params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection. Defaults to 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Verified live: values outside 1-100 return HTTP 400 `rest_invalid_param`.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by object attribute.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Only `view` and `embed` are available anonymously.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to categories with one of the given slugs.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit results to categories with the given parent term ID.

params.name: post
params.description: Limit results to categories assigned to a specific post ID.

params.name: hide_empty
params.description: Whether to hide categories with no assigned posts.

items.docs: Returns a paginated collection of Journal categories.
